propositions: Comment audit identified two size-pressured files (_store/event_append.py and reducer/_processors.py) whose comments are load-bearing replay-compatibility justifications and cannot be removed to recover headroom.

Five verified-stale comment blocks reference artifacts that no longer exist or have changed (llm_format.py module path, gitutil.py import claim, hlm.py release versioning, _filters.py bash/Python duality, _graph.py duplicate noqa), requiring correction or deletion.
The wire-format changelog exists in two homes (reducer/_version.py and docs/event-schema.md) with the docs copy partial and stale, missing v4/v5 entries, creating a single-source-of-truth debt.

Snapshot-restore migration guards in reducer/_processors.py:719-774 must remain in-place with their rationale intact, as relocating them would obscure live guards and one guard explicitly documents a constraint against unconditional execution.

The comment triage recovered 31 net lines across 8 files by collapsing redundancy, relocating changelog to canonical docs home, and correcting stale references without removing load-bearing rationale.
